summary: Specifies version 3 of the RFC Editor Model. Policy definition becomes the joint responsibility of the RFC Series Working Group, which proposes policy, and the RFC Series Approval Board, which approves it. Policy implementation is mainly the job of the RFC Production Center. It obsoletes RFC 8728 and was later replaced by RFC 9920.

eli5.summary: The group that publishes the RFCs had a rulebook for who does what. This version splits making the rules from carrying them out, with different groups for each.

questions: who is responsible for the rfc series
what is the rfc editor model
